title: AIm3 MentalArena Core Context — Light
purpose: Minimal project brain for MentalArena itself: what it is, what has been tested, and what v0.7 should prove.

blocks.title: Definition
blocks.text: MentalArena is an external reasoning/workflow layer above LLMs. It does not train model weights. It improves the protocol around LLMs: seed prompts, RHP/RHPr/RHPm prompting, multi-LLM answers, conflict extraction, targeted critique, judge/synthesis prompts, logs, lineage, and final human override.

blocks.title: Correct architecture split
blocks.text: The merged architecture is: Council Engine = heart of the system; Protocol Fitness Harness = measurement/CI/anti-bullshit layer; Public page = architecture explanation; Local Lab = private real work with API keys/logs.

blocks.title: Current strongest v0.7 thesis
blocks.text: The next proof target is narrow: conflict extraction. If MentalArena cannot extract substantive, decision-relevant disagreements better and faster than BD reading raw answers, it has no reason to become a larger council OS.

blocks.title: Manual workflow being automated
blocks.text: BD manual workflow: write seed → GPT/RHPr expands prompt → several top LLMs answer → answers collected into one file → GPT synthesizes → revised prompt goes back to LLMs → GPT/Claude build hybrid syntheses → final document. MentalArena should automate this without hiding human control.

blocks.title: Design stance
blocks.text: Treat BD as equal thinking partner; explore first; do not kill seeds early; build first, test hard second; no fake certainty; preserve minority useful ideas; prefer smallest decisive experiments over grand architecture.

blocks.title: v0.7 success gates
blocks.text: Conflict precision >= 60%; BD human reading time <= 60% of manual workflow; final output quality >= 90% of manual baseline; synthesis should beat or at least complement the best raw answer; cost must stay bounded; no semantic bleaching of useful disagreement.

blocks.title: Context-pack lesson
blocks.text: API MentalArena is weaker than project-folder GPT/Claude sessions unless models receive project materials. Add compact Project Context Packs so each LLM gets the same distilled input from papers, code, specs, and prior results.

usage_instruction: Use only what is relevant. Cite CTX ids when relying on this context. If context is insufficient or conflicts with the task, say so explicitly.
